name: Scroll 3D Showcase
description: Scroll-driven 3D model showcase: the camera completes a 360° orbit down the page, zooming into keyframed points of interest, with a game-style HUD over the top.
whenToUse: Talent, product or portfolio pages built around a single GLB where scrolling should feel like a camera move rather than a page scroll.

assets.note: Any GLB. The loader re-centres and re-scales it, so keyframe targetY values stay valid across models.

notes: TODO(rr): confirm — slice.json/slice.manifest.json shape was written without access to the rr repo's schema. Run audit:slices and reshape if the validator disagrees.

0.6.0 rebuilt the studio's navigation — chrome / rail / tabbed panel / transport / path map — with no change to <ShowcaseStudio>'s props. Every editor surface is a fixed overlay bar, so the canvas stays full-bleed and what you tune is the frame a visitor scrolls through.

The studio's two-level tab + mobile dock shape, its debounced undo stack, its uncontrolled sliders and its keyboard typing-guard are ported from the MIT-licensed framepilot editor. Code only: no dependency, styling, icon set or i18n came across.
Loads the GLB over XHR rather than GLTFLoader.load(): three wraps URLs in a Request object, which extensions that patch window.fetch cannot structured-clone.
Uses meshopt rather than Draco for geometry compression — the Draco decoder is fetched at runtime and would reintroduce that same failure.

0.12.0 added the studio's LIBRARY dialog — every model in one column, that model's whole preset as editable JSON in the other, with rename, publish, delete and delete-preset from inside it. Renames land on a new `label` column rather than `name`, because SYNC rewrites `name` from the scanned path on every run and a rename written there would silently revert.
